item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 05/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southerly airstream, the weather will be hot over the coast of southern China tomorrow. A trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to southern China on Sunday and Monday. Under the influence of a strong easterly airstream, the weather will be slightly cooler and will brighten gradually over the coast of Guangdong in the early and middle parts of next week. Besides, an area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather over the southern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days.

Date/Month: 06/05 (Saturday)
Wind: South to southeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Sunny periods and one or two showers.
Temp range: 26 - 31 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
